messages.author: Aila Nurmi
messages.text: Kimmo, the HUB-07 uplink to the core router shows CRC errors in bursts since about 05:00. The link stays up and most traffic flows, but customers report slowness.

messages.author: Henrik Sjöberg
messages.text: What does the optical level say?

messages.author: Aila Nurmi
messages.text: Receive power is normal on both ends.

messages.author: Henrik Sjöberg
messages.text: Then swap the SFP on our side anyway, it's cheap and we have had bad batches. Kimmo, can you do that on your way?

messages.author: Kimmo Rautio
messages.text: At HUB-07. Swapped the SFP, the link is up again.

messages.author: Aila Nurmi
messages.text: CRC errors are still climbing, same burst pattern.

messages.author: Henrik Sjöberg
messages.text: OK so not the SFP. Check the patch cord between the SFP and the ODF, clean both connectors and look for kinks.

messages.author: Kimmo Rautio
messages.text: Cleaned both connectors. Errors dropped a lot but not to zero. The patch cord looks fine to me, no kinks I can see. I have to leave for the next job, I'll come back tomorrow with a spare cord.

messages.author: Aila Nurmi
messages.text: OK, errors are at a low level for now. I will keep watching.

messages.author: Kimmo Rautio
messages.text: Has anyone found a parking permit for the Hakala depot? I have asked three times already.
